@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestLoadAuthenticationProviderRequiredFields(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, method := range []string{"github", "oidc"} {
+		for _, field := range []string{"client_id", "client_secret", "redirect_address"} {
+			for _, value := range []string{"", "   "} {
+				t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%q", method, field, value), func(t *testing.T) {
+					fields := map[string]string{
+						"client_id":        "client",
+						"client_secret":    "secret",
+						"redirect_address": "http://localhost/callback",
+					}
+					fields[field] = value
+
+					provider := "github"
+					methodConfig := "    github:\n      enabled: true\n"
+					indent := "      "
+					if method == "oidc" {
+						provider = "foo"
+						methodConfig = "    oidc:\n      enabled: true\n      providers:\n        bar:\n          client_id: client\n          client_secret: secret\n          redirect_address: http://localhost/callback\n        foo:\n"
+						indent = "          "
+					}
+					methodConfig += fmt.Sprintf("%sclient_id: %q\n%sclient_secret: %q\n%sredirect_address: %q\n",
+						indent, fields["client_id"], indent, fields["client_secret"], indent, fields["redirect_address"])
+
+					path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+					require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("authentication:\n  session:\n    domain: localhost\n  methods:\n"+methodConfig), 0600))
+
+					result, err := Load(path)
+					require.Nil(t, result)
+					require.EqualError(t, err, fmt.Sprintf("provider %q: field %q: non-empty value is required", provider, field))
+				})
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestLoadGithubAllowedOrganizationsScope(t *testing.T) {
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	content := `authentication:
+  session:
+    domain: localhost
+  methods:
+    github:
+      enabled: true
+      client_id: client
+      client_secret: secret
+      redirect_address: http://localhost/callback
+      allowed_organizations:
+        - flipt-io
+      scopes:
+        - read:org
+`
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0600))
+
+	_, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+}
+
+func TestLoadDisabledAuthenticationMethodsDoNotRequireCredentials(t *testing.T) {
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	content := `authentication:
+  methods:
+    github:
+      enabled: false
+    oidc:
+      enabled: false
+      providers:
+        foo: {}
+`
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0600))
+
+	_, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+}
